image.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: professional hairstyle-analysis teaching image for a mobile training app
Primary request: Create a realistic 2-by-2 contact sheet documenting the CURRENT haircut of one fictional adult East Asian woman from four consistent views: front, exact right profile, exact left profile, and exact back. This is one current-state record about a short bob growing out after roughly seven weeks, not a makeover and not a before/after comparison.

Scene/backdrop: identical plain warm light-gray studio background in every panel; no salon tools, mirrors, chairs, props or extra people.
Subject: the exact same fictional woman in every panel, early-to-mid 30s, natural unretouched skin, neutral relaxed expression, ordinary realistic appearance. Dark natural brown hair, medium-to-high density, medium-to-coarse-looking straight strands. Current haircut is a grown-out short bob: side lengths around the lower jaw, back baseline around the middle-to-lower nape, moderate compact weight through the lower sides, modest crown lift, no short bangs, softly open off-center part. The neckline is intentionally imperfect from regrowth: a naturally low, slightly irregular nape hairline is visible below the main back baseline, with small center and side nape sections growing upward and pushing outward into short wisps. The nape wisps must look like natural growth pattern and seven-week regrowth, not razor damage or a fresh designed texture. The main bob still has enough length and weight to partially cover and control the upper nape, while lower regrowth remains visible in the back and profile views.
Body/framing: full head, complete hair outline and baseline, both ears as naturally appropriate to the view, entire neck, both shoulders and upper chest visible in every panel. Keep posture and head level neutral; no head tilt.
Clothing: identical simple matte muted clay-beige wide crew-neck top in all four panels; no collar, jewelry or accessories, so the neck and shoulder relationship stays visible.
Style/medium: honest photorealistic studio reference photography with realistic individual strands, subtle flyaways, pores and everyday texture; no beauty filter, no glamour retouching.
Composition/layout: landscape 2-by-2 contact sheet with four equal panels and narrow neutral gutters. Top-left front, top-right exact right profile, bottom-left exact left profile, bottom-right exact back. Same camera height, subject scale, focal length, crop, shoulder level and soft diffused daylight in all panels.
Output intent: current-condition evidence for advanced hairstylist training about low nape hairline, upward-growing nape flow, neck exposure, outline stability and eight-to-ten-week haircut cycle.
Constraints/invariants: same identity, head and face proportions, neck and shoulder proportions, clothing, current haircut length, visible nape regrowth pattern and lighting in every panel. Only one adult person repeated across views. Show only the current grown-out haircut. No labels, no text, no arrows, no watermark. Do not show a cleaner proposed neckline, clipper result, haircut result, shaved undercut or design comparison.
Avoid: fresh polished salon finish, perfectly sharp new baseline, high undercut, shaved nape, skin fade, severe asymmetry, wet hair, dramatic curls, damaged-looking broken hair, hidden neck, cropped shoulders, three-quarter angles in place of true profiles, inconsistent hair length or identity, duplicated front views, dramatic makeup, face reshaping, glossy advertising finish.
